title: Understanding Large-Scale Dynamic Purchase Behavior
authors: Bruno Jacobs; Dennis Fok; A.C.D. Donkers
eligible_reason: Large-scale dynamic purchase model (LDA-type motivations with dynamics) estimated by variational inference on basket data. No treatment, no DiD.
design_notes: ulsdpb Python package: initialize_c_jm.py (collapsed Gibbs LDA initialization) and estimate.py (variational Bayes).
data_files_note: README.md: 'synthetic data files have been included with this package' to verify the installation.
data_provenance_note: Synthetic purchase, basket and customer data.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary or empty. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
